description: This PHP source file defines the DropfilesType class, a custom Symfony form type for uploading files using Dropzone, with support for handling documents and contracts and including transformers for model data conversion.

classes.name: DropfilesType
classes.description: A custom Symfony form type that provides file upload functionalities with support for documents and contract documents, utilizing transformers for data handling and supporting Dropzone.js integration.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Defines the form components and transformers for managing uploaded files, current files, and removed files.

methods.name: addCurrentViewAndModelTransformer
methods.description: Adds a form field for current files and applies a model transformer.

methods.name: addUploadsViewFileType
methods.description: Adds a form field for file uploads.

methods.name: addUploadsFieldModelTransformer
methods.description: Adds a transformer to the uploads field based on the type (document or contract).

methods.name: addUploadsTransformerAsDocument
methods.description: Transformer for handling document uploads, wrapping files in BaseDocument objects.

methods.name: addUploadsTransformerAsContractDocument
methods.description: Transformer for handling contract document uploads, wrapping files in Document objects.

methods.name: addRemovedViewCollectionType
methods.description: Adds a collection field for removed files.

methods.name: addRemovedFieldModelTransformer
methods.description: Applies a transformer to process removed file identifiers into model objects.

methods.name: addViewTransformer
methods.description: Adds a view transformer to handle presentation logic of files.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the form type, including data class, transformers, and UI text.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Prepares the form view with appropriate variables and attributes for rendering.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for block naming in Twig templates.
